main_text.p: stum. Quos per Puritanos intellexerit, ex ejus Dono Regio patet, id est, factio- sos quosdam in Scotia.
Manet ergo quod dictum fuit, Jesuitas voce & scriptis docere, licitum esse Reges privato ad id deputato occide- re: ejusque exempla Iesuitas complu- ria edidisse.
De quibus ita Iac. Aug. Thuanus in Elegia in Parricidas:

p.i: Nata Magistratum convellere, nata mi- nistris
Et viles regnantum animas, ipsosque necandos

main_text.head: DISSERTATIO XX. De Regnis DANIAE & NORWAGIAE.
main_text.p: 1. IMperium Danorum regna Daniae, Norwagiae, & hujus titulo Lapponiam Occiduam cum Islandiae Principatu, atque Gronlandiae littoralis tractum complectitur, vastas regiones, & in ultimum

page.notes: Page is a mix of roman and italic text; the heading "DISSERTATIO XX." is set in spaced capitals. The opening word "IMperium" has an enlarged initial I. Some words in the first lines are partly illegible on the scan; the printed "Iesuitas" and "Puritanos" are copied as printed. The opening line is a continuation from the previous page.
